renderer: Godot 4.6.3 Compatibility / OpenGL 4.5 / Mesa 25.0.7 llvmpipe LLVM 19.1.7
method: Standalone native HUD-only project on DISPLAY=:99. Same hud.gd, fixed representative real-value data and unchanged viewport. Baseline pre-batching comic_surface.gd versus optimized cached ArrayMesh helper. For each title/playing-rush/result/paused mode, wait 35 rendered frames, skip first 6, average RenderingServer RENDERING_INFO_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME over 29 frames. Snapshot at frame 7. No 3D/effects; this isolates UI draw submissions. Timing includes frame scheduling and is not full-world FPS.

pixelcomparison.method: Absolute RGB differences between baseline/optimized frame7 PNGs, mean over all RGB channels (0..255), fraction of pixels whose maximum channel difference exceeds10. Title is static; playing/result/paused can differ in animation phase because timing differs.

cache: Mesh key includes kind,size,fill,accent; meter filled segment count and low-pressure color; speed-edge phase/intensity/rush/reduced state; celebration phase/reduced state. Static objects reuse mesh. Live labels/buttons/settings controls are unchanged.
